{{Quote|Earlier this evening I was preparing a most elegant confection. Stewed, flaming collypods with tangerette cream and figs. Absolutely delicious!|Gab'borah Hise describes making a dish using collypods|<ref name="Boba Fett: Hunted">''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]''</ref>}}
'''Collypods''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of small [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] creature used in cooking. They were regularly served flambeed and then smothered in a thick broth.<ref name="CSWE" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Gab'borah Hise]] prepared stewed, flaming collypods with [[Tangerette]] cream and [[fig]]s, whilst he worked for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. Before the dish, which the cook considered delicious, was served to the Hutt, his [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Majordomo/Legends|Majordomo]] [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] tried a sample, but one collypod was still alive and as it was aflame, managed to set the Twi'lek's sleeve on fire. Hise managed to put out the fire and bribed Fortuna a [[Standard month/Legends|months]] worth of the cook's salary and a [[Ziziibbon truffle]] to persuade the majordomo not to have him thrown in the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|pit]] near [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Later that [[Standard day/Legends|day]] he recounted the tale to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] whilst traveling to Jabba's fortress in an air [[Yacht/Legends|yacht]].<ref name="Boba Fett: Hunted" />

==Behind the scenes==
Collypods were first mentioned in the [[2003]] young readers novel ''[[Boba Fett: Hunted]]'' written by [[Elizabeth Hand]]. They later received an entry in the [[2009]] reference [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
